# GCS El Salvador — Full Company Profile

> Grupo Integral De Construcciones y Servicios (GCS) is a construction, engineering, and permitting company based in El Salvador. With over 10 years of experience, 50+ team members, and a $37M+ project portfolio, GCS delivers residential and commercial construction projects across Central America and the United States.

## Company Overview

GCS El Salvador (Grupo Integral De Construcciones y Servicios) is a full-service construction and engineering firm headquartered in El Salvador. The company provides end-to-end project delivery — from initial permitting and regulatory navigation through engineering design to final construction. GCS also operates a heavy equipment rental division serving both internal projects and external clients.

### Identity

- **Full Name**: Grupo Integral De Construcciones y Servicios

- **Team Size**: 50+ professionals

### Key Metrics

- **Portfolio Value**: $37.73M USD
- **Active Projects**: 19+
- **Years in Operation**: 10+

---

## Services

### 1. Permitting & Regulatory Management

GCS handles all pre-construction documentation and institutional coordination to secure project approvals. Services include:
- OPAMSS pre-procedures and site qualification
- Hydrological studies
- Environmental impact assessments
- Institutional coordination with government bodies
- Full regulatory landscape navigation to prevent project delays

### 2. Engineering & Design

From initial concepts to final blueprints, the engineering team transforms client visions into precise, buildable plans:
- Conceptual design and feasibility studies
- Land surveys and topographical studies
- Structural engineering plans
- BIM-based (Building Information Modeling) 3D modeling
- Complete construction documentation packages

### 3. Residential Construction

GCS builds homes and residential developments designed to last:
- Custom single-family homes
- Multi-unit apartment complexes
- Residential developments and subdivisions
- Quality craftsmanship with modern design
- Full project management from foundation to finish

### 4. Commercial Construction

The commercial division delivers a range of business-oriented properties:
- Restaurants and food service facilities
- Retail spaces and shopping centers
- Office buildings and business parks
- Wellness and health complexes
- Commercial-grade standards compliance
- Complete timeline and budget management

### 5. Heavy Equipment Rental

GCS provides access to professional-grade construction equipment:
- **Excavators**: CAT 320 Series — 20-ton class for earthmoving, trenching, demolition
- **Concrete Mixers**: Heavy-duty transit mixers, 8-12 cubic meter drum capacity
- **Cranes**: Tower and mobile cranes, 5-80 ton capacity range
- **Dump Trucks**: Articulated models, 25-40 ton payload capacity
- Flexible rental terms available
- All equipment professionally maintained

### Field Fleet (site supervision & logistics)

- Mazda BT-50 (2024, silver) — 4x4 utility pickup
- Mazda BT-50 (2024, grey) — 4x4 utility pickup
- Mitsubishi L200 (2026, black) — 4x4 double-cab pickup
- Toyota Hilux Single Cab (2022, white) — work pickup

## Leadership Team

1. **José Max Hernández Sandoval** — CEO · Engineer — Director de Obra
   GCS's CEO and a licensed engineer. Max holds the COAMSS/OPAMSS "Director de Obra" accreditation — the highest credential a civil engineer or architect can earn in El Salvador, requiring nine years of government-verified experience. It authorizes him to take legal responsibility for construction of any kind. His track record spans El Chaparral, the Airport expansion, Bitcoin mining facilities in Berlín, and apartment towers; today no project can be built — and no company can legally operate as a construction firm — without a Director de Obra.
   - Accreditation: Director de Obra — Construcción y Supervisión (CS/3)
   - Issuing authority: COAMSS / OPAMSS (Oficina de Planificación del Área Metropolitana de San Salvador)
   - Registration: HJ046931663
   - Valid: 21 April 2026 – 21 April 2029

2. **Eduardo M** — COO (Chief Operating Officer)
   Leads day-to-day operations — coordinating projects, resources, and teams to deliver every job on time and to standard.

3. **Ricardo Cummings** — Director of Architecture
   Leads architectural design across the company's residential and commercial portfolio.
